legal_name.label: representation.text.entity_name
legal_name.why: The entity's registered legal name from the GLEIF golden copy. Inferred, the label is a draw between samples. The length bounds are NOT the label's: descriptor.overrides.json keeps the register's own (LEI-CDF NameType, 1 to 500 characters), because names shorter than two characters and longer than two hundred are genuinely registered and the label's bounds would refuse them.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: A derived search field: legal name, city and country, lowercased, accent-stripped and concatenated. It is free text by construction. Inferred, samples of this column come back `plain_text` on some runs and `unknown` on others, and `unknown` has been published before.
